full_judgment:
3. Upon these pleadings both parties adduced evidence in support of their respective cases. On a consideration of the same the learned Munsif found that the impugned deed of gift was fraudulently, obtained from the plaintiff by defendants Nos. 4 and 5 and further found that no consideration passed. Upon these findings the learned Munsif decreed the suit and cancelled the impugned deed of gift, On appeal, the learned Subordinate Judge found that the impugned deed of gift was executed by the plaintiff out of his free will fully understanding the contents thereof and there was no fraud or misrepresentation as alleged by the plaintiff and accordingly the learned Subordinate Judge set aside the judgment and decree passed by the trial court and dismissed the suit. 

 11. In the result, the appeal is allowed with costs. The judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge are hereby set aside and the judgment and decree passed by the learned Munsif are hereby affirmed. The connected Civil Rule No. 404(s) of 1969 arising out of the appeal is accordingly disposed of.
